summary: First-party DRC Ministry of Land Affairs discovery was completed in English and French. The ministry is evidenced as the national cadastral custodian, but no Kambove-specific local registry, open parcel map/API, safe native parcel ID, CRS, or polygon geometry was verified. No GeoJSON sample is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and French discovery queries, exact text, outcomes, and actual URLs are recorded in city-6131-kambove.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified public GET/search checks retrieved the official ministry home, current circonscriptions directory, public land-search workflow, and national procedure catalogue. The directory listed eight Haut-Katanga circonscriptions without Kambove. The BIC map route was checked as a secondary lead and reached an authentication wall; its landing page says coverage is Nord-Kivu/Sud-Kivu. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe query, or TLS-verification bypass was used.
attemptedRoutes: See city-6131-kambove.json sourceResearch.attemptedRoutes for every route and outcome.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point preserved; no parcel endpoint was available for an exact-point request.
National custodian evidence is not local Kambove registry evidence.
Directory omission, authentication wall, and lack of an open endpoint do not prove citywide cadastral absence.
No stable native parcel ID, source schema, CRS, or full parcel polygon was retrieved.
No unsafe fields were requested or retained.
